Visitor.title: Visitor
Visitor.description: A live visitor session in Elon Musk Space with location, intent, and latest message metadata.

visitorId.description: Unique identifier for the visitor session.

name.description: Display name of the visitor or Anonymous.

location.description: Detected city, region, and country of the visitor.

intentCategory.description: Primary reason for visiting Elon Musk Space.

intentSummary.description: Brief summary of visitor intent typed on entry.

lastMessagePreview.description: Preview text of the most recent message in this thread.

unreadForOwner.description: Count of unread messages for the owner console.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when visitor session started.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when visitor session was last updated.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: A real-time chat message between a visitor and Elon Musk (Owner).

visitorId.description: ID of the visitor thread this message belongs to.

intentCategory.description: Intent tag associated with the conversation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was sent.

OwnerPresence.title: OwnerPresence
OwnerPresence.description: Live Starbase presence and profile settings for the Owner Console.

ownerTitle.description: Active owner title and verification badge status.

statusText.description: Live presence location text (e.g., Online in Starbase).

isOnline.description: Whether owner is actively online in Starbase.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last presence update.

/visitors/{visitorId}.description: Stores live visitor sessions, detected location, intent category, and last message preview.

/messages/{messageId}.description: Stores all real-time 1-on-1 chat messages between visitors and Elon Musk (Owner).

/presence/{presenceId}.description: Stores live Starbase presence and owner profile settings.
